verdict.rationale: Supermemory is positioned as a memory API/infrastructure layer that other AI agents and assistants plug into via MCP or SDK, not as a product with its own built-in AI assistant that end-users delegate tasks to. The closest evidence (docs-32, docs-20) mentions a 'personal supermemory' consumer app, but there is no documentation of a built-in assistant that can take on and execute delegated tasks inside the product itself. Missing for 10: any documented built-in assistant UI/chat capability, evidence of task delegation/execution within the product, and independent confirmation of such a feature.
